title: Second Pass --- What Was Met Once
label: ch:pa-doosra-gera
canDo: I can fill every A1 form field at each level of support, read every Gurmukhi piece this book taught once, and place each courtesy and parting word in its register.

payoff.summary: From cold: say please, sorry and welcome, name the verb or case ending inside each, and place the three partings in their registers.
payoff.note: The chapter introduces NO atom. It exists because forty pre-A1 atoms were taught once and never asked for again, spread across seventeen path segments -- too scattered for any one earlier chapter to reach. Six lessons in three strands: the form-field ladder, the Gurmukhi pieces, and the courtesy and parting words.
